name: ESO 252-IG001 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 252-IG001, a nearby dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso252ig001-hubble
story: What looks like a pair of interacting galaxies is really two galaxies seen in projection: a nearby dwarf irregular in front and a much more distant, nearly edge-on galaxy behind it. Hubble looked here to measure the dwarf's distance from the brightest of its red giant stars.

claims.text: HIPASS J0457-42 (ESO 252-IG001 NED01) is a nearby dwarf irregular galaxy, the western member of the apparent pair ESO 252-IG001
ESO 252-IG001 looks like an interacting pair but is two galaxies viewed in projection, with HIPASS J0457-42 in the foreground
The eastern galaxy of the pair is nearly edge-on, much more distant and not a companion
ESO252-001 was a target of Hubble program 12546, which measures distances to nearby galaxies from the tip of the red giant branch
